# Solution Conventions

Project folder structure should follow Next.js conventions for organizing routes, layouts, assets, and supporting files.

## When to Use

Use this skill when creating or reorganizing project structure, especially when deciding where application files and folders should live.

## Procedure

Keep the project structure aligned with Next.js conventions. Place routing files, layouts, shared assets, and related project folders where Next.js expects them.
